dict.string: Buntini listens only while you hold the dictation key or press the mic, during a voice conversation you start, while a call you record runs, and for “Hey Buntini” if you turn it on. Your voice is turned into words on this Mac.
Buntini records the Mac's sound only while you record a call, so your notes include everyone on it. The audio stays on this Mac and is deleted once the notes are written.
Buntini turns your voice into words on this Mac with Apple's speech recognition.
